source.raw_extract: Każdego roku NAWA przeprowadza **dwa oddzielne nabory wniosków o stypendium**. Szczegółowe informacje o zasadach i wytycznych obowiązujących w naborach w 2026 roku, znajdują się odpowiednio w ogłoszeniach o naborze wniosków o stypendium na: - [**studia I stopnia i jednolite magisterskie**](https://www.nawa.gov.pl/studenci/studenci-zagraniczni/program-im-gen-andersa/nabory-2026/studia-i-stopnia/ogloszenie-anders) – termin składania wniosków upływa 9 lipca 2026 r. - [**studia II stopnia**](https://www.nawa.gov.pl/studenci/studenci-zagraniczni/program-im-gen-andersa/nabory-2026/studia-ii-stopnia/ogloszenie-anders-nawa) – termin składania wniosków 21 maja 2026 r.
source.exact_deadline_wording: termin składania wniosków upływa 9 lipca 2026 r.
source.notes: study.gov.pl/general-władysław-anders returns HTTP 404. NAWA's own 2026 call page states two different deadlines because the programme runs two separate rounds per year. Per the brief, different rounds of the same institution are not a conflict. I have written the first-cycle/unified-master's round (9 July 2026) because it is the current round listed as open on the 2026 calls page; the second-cycle round closed 21 May 2026. Both 2026 deadlines are now in the past as of 2026-10-05, so the record's open/upcoming flag needs human review. The English 'Calls for proposals 2026' page links announcement no. 13/2026 dated 31 March 2026 for first-cycle studies, consistent with this.

records.deadline_display: The National Commission of invited Member States will select qualified candidates and transmit to UNESCO the Letters of Endorsement and all the application documents of the nominated candidates ... by Monday 26 May 2025, Midnight Paris time at the latest.

source.publisher: UNESCO (co-sponsored by the Polish National Commission for UNESCO and the UNESCO Chair at AGH University)
source.raw_extract: # UNESCO/Poland Co-Sponsored Fellowships in Engineering 2025 edition Last update:13 June 2025 ... **The 2025 edition of this Programme is closed for applications.** ... The National Commission of invited Member States will select qualified candidates and transmit to UNESCO the Letters of Endorsement and all the application documents of the nominated candidates, by e-mail to agh.poland@unesco.org ... **by Monday 26 May 2025, Midnight Paris time at the latest.** Candidatures with incomplete applications, or submitted after this deadline won't be considered. ... Due to the intergovernmental character of UNESCO, individual applications will not be accepted by UNESCO. Only applications endorsed by the National Commissions for UNESCO will be considered.
source.exact_deadline_wording: by Monday 26 May 2025, Midnight Paris time at the latest.
source.notes: Live verification corrects one detail in the shard: the 2025 edition deadline was 26 May 2025, not 'Monday 26 May 2025' stated as Monday is correct, and the fellowship ran 1 October 2025 to 31 March 2026 as the shard said. The page is explicitly marked closed and no 2026/27 edition or deadline is published, so the only official date available is in the past. Per the brief I set expired_mismatch and did not write the stale date or move it to 2027. study.gov.pl/unescopoland-co-sponsored-fellowships-programme-engineering still describes the 2023 edition (deadline 9 June 2023) and is older, so UNESCO is the correct higher-tier source. Note applications are only accepted via National Commissions, never directly from individuals.

The page states that the Polish National Agency is the Foundation for the Development of the Education System and defers all detail to that body and to individual institutions, but does not itself state a deadline. I am not upgrading this to ROLLING, because the source never uses rolling language or says there is no fixed deadline, and I am not inventing an institution-level date. Genuine UNKNOWN.

source.raw_extract: **When to apply: ** February-April ... **When to apply: ** May-October ... **When to apply: ** February-May ... **When to apply: ** May-September ... **When to apply: ** September-December
source.notes: study.gov.pl/fulbright-program carries no deadline at all and only links out to the Commission. The Commission's own pages give per-award application WINDOWS in month ranges (Graduate Student Award February-April, Junior Research Award May-October, Polish Scholar Award February-May, Polish Studies Award May-September, STEM Impact Award February-May, Schuman September-December), and the linked 'Call for applications' pages are stated to be in Polish only. This record is the umbrella 'Fulbright Program (Poland-US)' with no specific award, and the windows differ per award, so there is no single deadline to record. Per the brief I am not picking one award's window and I am not converting a month range into a date. Not CONFLICTING either: these are different awards, not two sources disagreeing about one deadline.

source.raw_extract: Which deadlines do apply? **June 1st:** network mobility applications for the following winter term **November 1st**: network mobility application for the following summer term **July 1st and November 1st:** Freemover-applications, where applicable ... When can I start a network application? The call for applications will be launched by the end of September 2026. Deadline for the 27/28 network applications is **November 30th**.
source.notes: Two different things are published and neither is this record's deadline. (1) The network application round: ceepus.info's home page news dated 21 September 2026 says 'Network Application Round 2027/28 enabled / Deadline: 30th November, 2026, 23:59 CET. Extended deadline for signed documents (letters): 15th December, 2026, 23:59 CET', and /content/how confirms 'Deadline for the 27/28 network applications is November 30th'. That is an exact date but it is for institutions/network coordinators applying for network funding, not for scholarship applicants. (2) The individual mobility/scholarship deadlines are stated only as recurring month-days with no year: network mobility by June 1st (winter term) or November 1st (summer term), freemover by July 1st and November 1st. Those would be ANNUAL, but this record is the umbrella exchange programme with no fixed direction or applicant type, and the brief forbids inventing a day for a recurring rule without a stated current date, so I am reporting UNKNOWN rather than picking one. To be explicit about a near miss: I did not write 2026-11-30, because that is the network round and writing it as this record's scholarship deadline would be wrong; if a future shard scopes this record to the 2027/28 network round, that date becomes EXACT.

rejected_sources.reason: describes the programme generally and publishes no deadline; points only to ceepus.info

source.raw_extract: Dostępnych jest wiele stypendiów na warunkach określonych w umowach dwustronnych. Są one finansowane przez rząd polski lub rząd partnera zagranicznego, często w celu zwiększenia wymiany studentów z określonego kierunku geograficznego lub w obszarze danego kierunku studiów. Kwota stypendium zależy od poziomu studiów. Więcej informacji na ten temat można znaleźć na stronie Narodowej Agencji Wymiany Akademickiej www.nawa.gov.pl . Rekrutacją na pobyty stypendialne w ramach umów i porozumień dwustronnych zajmują się właściwe instytucje, koordynujące wymianę akademicką w krajach pochodzenia kandydatów.
source.notes: The English official_source_url /polish-government-scholarships returns HTTP 404; the live equivalent on the same official domain is the Polish page /pl/stypendia-w-ramach-um-w-dwustronnych, which I fetched. It publishes no deadline and states that recruitment for bilateral scholarship stays is handled by the relevant institutions coordinating exchange in the candidates' countries of origin. That is an explicit statement that there is no single central deadline, but the page does not use the words 'rolling' or 'no fixed deadline', so I am not upgrading to ROLLING. Genuine UNKNOWN, not invented.

source.notes: Important correction to the shard: the record's title implies an open initiative, but study.gov.pl's news page is undated ('05 Oct') and links to this NAWA article, which is explicitly the 2021 edition ('edycja 2021', article dated 30.09.2021) with a deadline of 20 October 2021, 15:00 Warsaw time. So the only official deadline is nearly five years stale. Per the brief: expired_mismatch, stale date not written, not silently moved to 2026 or 2027. The study.gov.pl English text 'will be able to submit applications ... until October 20' omits the year, which is exactly the kind of undated wording that must not be turned into a current date.
